about: The loading screen's view model (XAML Public/Game/GUI/Widgets/LoadingScreen.xaml, context LoadingScreen, shown by the UI state Loading with BlockedLoading). Properties: Progress (float 0..1) and LoadingStateInfo from its base ui::DCLoadingScreen; LoadingState (enum gui::DCLoadingScreen::ELoadingState: Initial 0, CharacterCreation 1, MultiplayerLobby 2, Tutorial 3, Level 4), LevelName, LoadingHints (two VMLoadingHint slots), VisibileHintIndex, Data, CurrentPlayer, AdvanceHintCommand. On macOS LoadingState +0x270, LevelName +0x278, hints collection +0x2c8, VisibileHintIndex +0x2e8, seed +0x2fc, HintManager +0x308; dx11 offsets not read.
